package mapmodify

// Map updates outside a list of statements.
func Modify() map[int]int {
	m := make(map[int]int)
	for i := 0; i < 3; m[i]++ {
		i++
	}
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
	again:
		m[i] += 10
		if m[i] < 30 {
			goto again
		}
	}
	return m
}
